testCases.name: [FC-ONB-01] Fresh Install: Language → Home → Feed Loads
testCases.description: Fresh install: pick a language and land on home with the feed loaded.

testCases.name: [FC-AGENT-01] Agentic: Vague Question → Clarification → Answer
testCases.description: A vague question gets a clarification card, then a complete answer.

testCases.name: [FC-CHAT-01] Typed Question → Answer → Follow-up → Back to Home
testCases.description: Typed question gets a complete answer; a follow-up question gets one too.
testCases.retry_issues: Attempt 1:         Agent finished its turn after the card... FAILED       Run flow when true is true... FAILED     Repeat while id: chat_suggested_questions is not visible (up to 4 times)... FAILED

testCases.name: [FC-FEED-01] First Feed Card → Ask Now → Answer
testCases.description: First feed card's Ask Now opens a chat with a complete answer.

testCases.name: [FC-PHOTO-01] Photo Question from Gallery → AI Response
testCases.description: A gallery photo sent as a question gets a complete answer.

testCases.name: [FC-LOC-01] Weather → Share Location (granted) → Answer
testCases.description: Weather asks for location; once granted, a complete weather answer arrives.

testCases.name: [FC-AUTH-01] Account Lifecycle: Sign Up → History → Log Out
testCases.description: Sign up with phone and OTP, reopen this run's chat from Chat History, then log out.

testCases.name: [FC-TTS-01] Listen to AI Response (TTS Playback)
testCases.description: Listen plays an answer aloud and pauses on a second tap.
testCases.retry_issues: Attempt 1: Listen button centred on screen... FAILED  No visible element found: id: chat_listen_btn
